brief:
Deadly floods across Gaza have sparked calls from Australia, Canada, the UK, and Italy for Israel to permit safe passage of critical humanitarian aid before winter arrives, The Guardian reported. The four governments warned that the disaster has created a dire humanitarian crisis requiring immediate relief supplies.

Winter is approaching as conditions deteriorate in Gaza. No timeline was specified for when Israel might respond to the calls.
dek: Deadly floods in Gaza have created a dire humanitarian crisis, as the governments of Australia, Canada, the UK and Italy call on Israel to allow the safe passage of critical aid to civilians before winter sets in.
title: Four nations urge Israel to allow aid into flood-ravaged Gaza
